notes: ONS Price Index of Private Rents (PIPR), County Durham, December 2015 value. This is ONS's modelled MEAN average private rent, not a true median -- ONS's separate Private Rental Market Summary Statistics series does publish a true median for County Durham, but only from Oct 2018-Sep 2019 onward (discontinued Dec 2023), so it cannot cover this full period alone. Used here as the best available full-coverage annual series; flagged as a mean-vs-median methodology note rather than a literal median.
